verses.en: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.sm: Isaraelu ) Ua faapotopotoina e Peniata le tupu o Suria O ana “au uma; sa la te la o tupu e tolugafulu ma le lua, ma “au e tietie i solofanua, ma kariota; ua alu ae o ia, ma vagaia Samaria, ma tau ai le taua.

verses.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,
verses.sm: Ua auina mai e la le savali i le aai ia Aapo le tupu o Isaraelu,

verses.en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai ia te ia, O loo faapea ona fai mai o Peniata, O lau ario ma lau auro, o aʻu ia; o au aua foi, ma au fanau, O e ua sili ona lelei, o au ia.

verses.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, Le alii e, le tupu, o au nei, ma aʻu mea uma o au ia, e pei ona e fetalai mai ai.

verses.en: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
verses.sm: Ua toe foi mai le savali, ma latou fai mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Peniata, ua faapea mai, E ui lava ina alu atu laʻu feau ia te oe, ua faapea, Ia e au mai ma'u au ario, ma au auro, ma au ava, ma au fanau;

verses.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
verses.sm: a o le itu la faapenei taeao, Ou te aauina atu ai aʻu auauna ia te oe, ina ia latou suesue i lou fale, ma fale o au auauna; o mea uma foi ua e fiafia i ai, latou te tago i o latou lima, ma latou avea.

verses.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.sm: Ona tala‘i lea e le tupu o Isaraelu o toeaina uma O le nuu, ma fai atu, Faauta mai ia, ma ia outou iloa, o loo sailiili lenei tagata i se mea leaga; aua na aauina mai e la nisi ia te au e ave i aʻu ava, ma au fanau, ma aʻu ario, ma aʻu auro; ua ou le faafiti atu foi ia te ia.

verses.en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea ia te ia o toeaina uma, ma le nuu uma, Aua e te faafofoga, pe usiusitai ia te ja,

verses.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia i le savali a Peniata, Ia outou faapea atu i loʻu alii le tupu, O mea uma na e muai fetalai mai ai i lau auauna ou te faia; a o lenei mea ou te le mafaia. Ona O lea o le savali, ma latou ave le upu ia te ia.

verses.en: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
verses.sm: Ona aauina mai lea nisi e Peniata ia te ia, ua ia fai mai, Ia faapea ona fai e atua ia te au, ma ia faaopoopo i ai, pe afai e lava le efuefu o Samaria ia tofu ai ma luutaga i le nuu uma o e mulimuli ia te au.

verses.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, Ina fai atu ia ia te ia, Aua le mitamita le ua fusi ia te ia i le ofu tau, e pei o le na te tatalaina.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Peniata i lena upu, a o feinu o ia ma tupu i fale apitaga; ona fai atu lea o ia i ana auauna, Ina totofi ia le taua. Ona latou tofia lea o le taua i le aai.

verses.en: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Faauta, na sau le tasi perofeta ia Aapo le tupu o Isaraelu, ua fai mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua e iloa atu ea lena vao tagata uma e toatele? Faauta, ou te tuuina atu i latou i lou lima i le aso nei; ona e iloa ai lea o aʻu o le ALII.

verses.en: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Aapo, E faia ea e ai? Ona fai mai lea o ia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, O taulelea o i alii e pule i itu. Ona fai atu lea o ia, O ai ea na te amataina le taua? Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, O oe lava.

verses.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
verses.sm: Ona faitau lea e ia o taulelea o i alii e pule i itu; e lua selau ma le tolu sefulu ma le toalua; e mulimuli ane ia te i latou na faitau e ia o le nuu uma, o le fanauga uma a Isaraelu e fitu gaafe.

verses.en: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o i latou i le tutonu o le la. A o Peniata ma tupu, o tupu e toatolugafulu ma le toalua o e fesoasoani ia te ia, sa latou feinu ia ona i fale apitaga.

verses.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
verses.sm: Ua muamua atu taulelea o i alii e pule i itu. Ona aauina atu lea e Peniata nisi, ona latou taʻu mai lea ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Ua o mai tagata mai Samaria.

verses.en: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, Pe afai o le filemu ua latou o mai ai, ia outou pupue ola ia te i latou; pe afai foi o le taua ua latou o mai ai, ia outou pupue ola ia te i latou.

verses.en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
verses.sm: Ua o atui tua o le aai ia taulelea o i alii e pule i itu, ma ʻau na mulimuli ia te i latou.

verses.en: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
verses.sm: Ua latou taitasi ma fasioti i lana tagata; ona sosola lea o Suria; ua piituli Isaraelu ia te i latou. Ua sao Peniata le tupu o Suria i le solofanua, faatasi ma e tietie i solofanua.

verses.en: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu le tupu o Isaraelu, ma fasia solofanua ma kariota; ua ia fasiotia foi Suria i le fasi tele.

verses.en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
verses.sm: Ona sau lea o le perofeta i le tupu o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu ia te ia, Ina maliu atu ia oe, ma e faamalosi, ma e faautauta, ma ia e silafia mea e te faia; aua pe a toe oo i le tausaga, ona sau ai lea o le tupu O Suria e tau ma oe.

verses.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu auauna a le tupu o Suria ia te ia, O atua o mauga o latou atua, o le mea lea na manumalo ai i latou ia te i tatou; a ia tatou tau ma i latou i se mea laugatasi, ai lava tatou te manumalo ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
verses.sm: Ia e faia lenei mea, ia e faateaina tupu taitasi i lona tofi, ma e tofia o e avea ‘au e sui a“ i latou.

verses.en: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
verses.sm: Ia e faitauina foi mo ce o ‘au e tusa ma ‘au na faaumatia sa ia te oe; ia suia le solofanua i le solofanua, ma le kariota i le kariota; ona tatou tau ai lea ma i latou i se mea laugatasi, ai lava tatou te manumalo ai ia te i latou. Ua faalogo o ia i a latou upu, ma fai i ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
verses.sm: Ua toe oo i le tausaga, ona faitaulia lea e Peniata o Suria, ua alu ae i Afeka e tau ma Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
verses.sm: Ua faitaulia foi le fanauga a Isaraelu, ma ua latou sauniuni uma lava; ona latou o lea e faafetaiai ia te i latou. Ua to lauapi le fanauga a Isaraelu ua faafeagai ma i latou, e pei o lafu “on itiiti e lua; a ua tumu le nuu ia Suria.

verses.en: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona sau lea o le tagata o le Atua, ma fai mai i le tupu o Isaraelu, ua faapea mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua faapea mai Suria, O le Atua o mauga le ALII, a e le o le Atua o vanu; o le ` mea lea ou te tuuina atu ai o lena vao tagata uma e toatele i lou lima; ona outou iloa lava lea, o aʻu lava o le ALII.

verses.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
verses.sm: E fitu po ua latou to lauapi e faafeagai ai. Ua oo i le aso fitu, ona latou tau ai lea o le taua; ona fasiotia lea e le fanauga a Isaraelu o Suria e selau afe o ‘au e savavali, i le aso e tasi.

verses.en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
verses.sm: O e na totoe ua sosola i latou i Afeka, i le aai; ua solo i lalo le pa i luga o tagata e luafulu o afe ma afe e fitu o e na totoe. Ua sola Peniata, ua 00 i le aai, i le afeafe tuloto.

verses.en: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ana auauna ia te ia, Faauta mai ia, ua matou faalogo, o tupu o le aiga o Isaraelu, o tupu alolofa i latou; seʻi matou lavalava i ie talatala į o matou sulugatiti, ma maea i o matou ulu, matou te o atu foi i le tupu o Isaraelu; atonu na te faasoifua ia te oe.

verses.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
verses.sm: Ona latou fusi lea o ie talatala i o latou sulugatiti, ma maea i o latou ulu, ma latou o atu i le tupu o Isaraelu, ma latou fai atu, O loo fai mai lau auauna o Peniata, Seʻi e faaola mai ia te au. Ona fai mai lea o ia, Ua soifua pea ea ia? O loʻu uso ia.

verses.en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
verses.sm: Ua faanaunau atu le nuu i se upu mai ia te ia, ma latou vave taofi i ai; ona latou fai atu lea, O lou uso o Peniata. Ona fai mai lea o ia, Ina o ia, ma au mai ia te ia. Ona sau ai lea o Peniata; ua talia foi o ia e ia i lona kariota.

verses.en: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Peniata ia te ia, O aai na faoa e loʻu tama nai lou tama ou te toe avatua; e te fai foi ni ala i Tamaseko mo oe, e pei ona faia e lo‘u tama i Samaria. Ona fai atu lea o Aapo, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe e alu ma la ta feagaiga nei. Ona la faia lea o le feagaiga ma ia; ona ia tuu atu lea ia te ia e alu.

verses.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
verses.sm: O le tasi soo o le au perofeta na fai atu o ia i le afioga a le ALI i le tasi tagata, Ia e ta mai ia te au. A ua le mafai le tagata ona ta ia te ia.

verses.en: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o iaia te ia, Ua e le faalogo i le afioga a le ALII, faauta mai, o le mea lea a e alu ese ia te au e oti ai oe i le leona. Ua alu ia nai ia te ia, ona maua lea o ia e le leona, ua oti ai o ia.

verses.en: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
verses.sm: Ua iloa foi e ia le tasi tagata, ona ia fai atu lea ia te ia, Seʻi e ta mai ia te au. Ona ta atu lea o le tagata ia te ia, o lana ta foi na manua ai o ia.

verses.en: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
verses.sm: Ona alu lea o le perofeta, ua tu atu i le tupu i le ala; ua ia faauigaeseina o la e ia i le fusi i ona mata.

verses.en: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
verses.sm: Ua alu ane le tupu, ona valaau atu lea o ia i le tupu, ua faapea atu, Na alu ane lau auauna i totonu o le taua; faauta, ua liliu mai le tasi tagata, ma ia au mai ia te au le tagata, ua fai mai, Ia e leoleo i lenei tagata; afai lava e le iloa o ia, ona suia lea o lona ola i lou ola, pe e te aumaia le taleni o ario.

verses.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
verses.sm: Na faia e lau auauna ana feau i lea mea ma lea mea, ona leai lea o ia. Ona fai atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu ia te ia, E faapea lau sala, o ce lava ua e faatonuina.

verses.en: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
verses.sm: Ona ave ese loa lea o le fusi ai ona mata; ona iloa lea e le tupu o Isaraelu, o so le au perofeta o ia.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia te ia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua e tuu atu e alu le tagata na tofia e aʻu ia oti, o le mea lea e suia ai lona ola i lou ola, ma lona nuu i lou nuu.

verses.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu i lona fale ua tiga ma ita; ua 00 ia i Samaria.
